name: rendex
label: Rendex
description: Render HTML, a URL or Markdown to an image or PDF, extract page content, create render links and branded documents, and watch web pages for changes.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Your Rendex API key (it starts with rdx_). Sign in at rendex.dev, open the dashboard and copy a key under API Keys. The free plan includes 100 renders per month.

get_account.label: Get Account Usage
get_account.description: Get your Rendex plan, credits used and remaining this month, and your per-minute rate limit.

get_watch.label: Get Watch
get_watch.description: Get one website change watch with its settings, status and last check.

watch_id.label: Watch
watch_id.description: The watch to use. You can also map a Watch ID from List Watches or Create Watch.

delete_watch.label: Delete Watch
delete_watch.description: Permanently delete a website change watch and its check history.
